item.title: Open Source Upgrading
item.description:
Docker compose

When you deploy a vanilla docker compose, it will create a persistent volume for your Postgres database. As long as your volume is there, you should not lose any data.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.4.300
item.description:
The endpoint field of /api/v2/endpoint_status/

With Locations enabled, the endpoint field of /api/v2/endpoint_status/ now carries the id that /api/v2/endpoints/ lists for the Finding’s Asset, the same ID the ?endpoint= filter takes. It used to carry the Location’s ID, which only matched /api/v2/endpoints/ when the two IDs happened to be equal. The Location’s ID is still in location_id.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.4.200
item.description:
DefectDojo Pro: the classic sidebar is removed

The reorganized sidebar is now the only navigation in the DefectDojo Pro UI. The classic sidebar and the Menu 2.0 toggle on the Feature Flags page are removed. This change applies to DefectDojo Pro only. The open source UI is unaffected.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.4.100
item.description:
Deprecated API endpoints: corrected end-of-life date

The deprecated Tool Type, Tool Configuration, and API Scan Configuration API endpoints send a corrected end-of-life date. They now send X-End-Of-Life-Date: 2026-11-02T00:00:00, the actual 3.5.0 release day. The earlier value was 2026-11-01T00:00:00, one day off.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.5.x
item.description: There are no special instructions for upgrading to 3.5.x. Check the Release Notes for the contents of the release.

item.title: Adding the Webhook Gateway on Upgrade
item.description: DefectDojo Pro can put a webhook gateway in front of Triage Engine webhook receivers, the URLs Jira and other tools post to for two-way sync. The gateway stores each webhook and answers the sender before DefectDojo is involved, then delivers it with retries, so a DefectDojo restart or short outage loses nothing.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.3.200
item.description:
Feature Flags toggles reach the Classic UI and /api/v2 after a restart (DefectDojo Pro)

Two features on the Settings > Feature Flags page, Locations and Organization / Asset Relabeling, have parts that are decided when DefectDojo starts: the Classic UI pages and labels, the /api/v2 endpoint and location routes, and the /api/v3/ API. Both carry a Restart Recommended tag for that reason.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.4.x
item.description: There are no special instructions for upgrading to 3.4.x. Check the Release Notes for the contents of the release.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.2.200
item.description:
Locations is now a self-service toggle (DefectDojo Pro)

In DefectDojo Pro, Locations moves from an environment-managed setting to a database-backed toggle on the Settings > Feature Flags page. You no longer need a deployment change or a Support request to turn it on: the toggle drives the Pro UI and the import pipeline live, with no restart.

item.title: Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.2.100
item.description:
Private notes are now limited to their author

Before 3.2.100, a note marked Private was still served to every user who could view the object it was attached to. The flag changed how the note was labelled, not who received it.
